description: Case no. 26-009 MA – 450 Charles Street Applicant: 329 Development LLC The applicant is requesting to combine master and preliminary plan approval to construct a building that will serve as a contractor's storage yard in the M-1 zone. The applicant is requesting waivers from submission of state approvals and a signage plan at the preliminary plan stage – for vote (AP 76 Lot 529, Charles) Mr. Manjrekar introduced the item. Attorney Joseph Carnevale presented the item with engineers David Bray and Kevin Harrop. He explained the project's design and said commercial projects had previously been approved for the site and was suited for development.
